tagline: A modular elastin-like polypeptide coating platform that lets one implant surface be tuned to the tissue, and the patient, it sits in.
tagline_zh: 一個模組化的類彈性蛋白多肽塗層平台，讓同一種植入物表面能依其所在的組織、以及病人本身來調整。
summary: MOSAIC is a modular implant coating built from elastin-like polypeptides (ELPs) that can be swapped part by part so a single platform serves many implants and tissues. The team's insight is that an implant coating has to match the stiffness and biochemistry of its target tissue: tissue stiffness spans 0.1 kPa in brain to over 1 MPa in bone, while titanium is around 100 GPa, so a one-size coating gives cells the wrong signal. They built five linked models to steer design before the lab work - an XGBoost predictor of ELP transition temperature, coarse-grained molecular dynamics of the surface-tethered hydrogel, an omics pipeline turning transcriptomic and proteomic atlases into tissue-specific coating recipes, a SuperPro Designer scale-up of ELP manufacturing, and a life-cycle assessment of that process - and they ran Value Sensitive Design across 13 interviews so stakeholders shaped the construct while it could still change. It took the Overgrad Grand Prize along with Best Wiki, Best Integrated Human Practices and Best Biomanufacturing Project.
summary_zh: MOSAIC 是一種以類彈性蛋白多肽（ELP）構成的模組化植入物塗層，可逐一替換部件，因此單一平台就能服務多種植入物與組織。該隊的洞見是：植入物塗層必須匹配目標組織的硬度與生化特性；組織硬度從腦部的 0.1 kPa 到骨骼的超過 1 MPa，而鈦約為 100 GPa，所以一體適用的塗層只會給細胞錯誤的訊號。他們建了五個互相銜接的模型，在進實驗室之前先引導設計——以 XGBoost 預測 ELP 轉變溫度、對表面接枝水膠做粗粒化分子動力學模擬、一條把轉錄體與蛋白體圖譜轉成組織專一塗層配方的體學流程、用 SuperPro Designer 做 ELP 生產的放大模擬，以及該製程的生命週期評估——並在 13 場訪談中貫徹價值敏感設計（Value Sensitive Design），讓利害關係人在構築體還能改的階段就參與塑形。本隊拿下 Overgrad 組總冠軍，同時獲得最佳 Wiki、最佳整合式人類實踐與最佳生物製造專案。

dry.frameworks: Five models, each tied to a design question. (1) LCST prediction: an XGBoost regressor trained on 230 literature-curated entries predicting ELP transition temperature from sequence composition, length, charge, hydrophobicity and solution conditions, with monotonic constraints forcing predicted LCST to fall as NaCl, ELP concentration or hydrophobicity rise, 216-combination exhaustive grid search over six hyperparameters under composition-grouped 5-fold CV, and a held-out set of 43 entries covering only 10 unique sequences; MAE 3.17 C, beating a linear fit of the Meyer-Chilkoti empirical relation, a 5-nearest-neighbour model and a mean baseline. (2) Molecular dynamics: coarse-grained CALVADOS 0.8.0 with CALVADOS 2 residue parameters in OpenMM 8.2 (one bead per residue, implicit solvent, Debye-Huckel screening, 293.15 K, 10 fs timestep, Langevin thermostat) simulating 16-chain surface-tethered ELP brushes on DelftBlue, the TU Delft supercomputer - chosen explicitly because ELPs are intrinsically disordered and AlphaFold is of limited use. Three MD modules resolve hydrogel stiffness (inter-chain lysine contacts as a proxy), crosslink placement (bridges versus wasted intra-chain loops) and RGD motif solvent accessibility, analysed by response surface modelling and per-lysine regression. (3) Omics-guided motif selection: an enhancement-based test across Human Protein Atlas bulk RNA-seq, the Proteome Atlas DIA-MS intensities, Tabula Sapiens single-cell via CZ CELLxGENE, and GEO datasets (GSE104782, GSE169396, GSE147287, GSE114007), annotated by matrisome, integrin and protease category, with per-dataset thresholds (HPA: >4x the mean of other tissues above 1 nTPM, plus stricter floors of 10 nTPM for ECM ligands and 3 nTPM for integrins) producing an ECM adhesion domain, an integrin target and a targetable protease per implant tissue. (4) Large-scale production: a pilot bioprocess in SuperPro Designer with three consecutive reactors reaching 5.11 g/L ELP, sized to coat 117 million and 22 million continuous glucose monitors, with full catabolic, anabolic and glycerol metabolic balances, downstream ITC/salting-out, homogenisation, flocculation, ion exchange and lyophilisation. (5) Environmental impact: an ISO 14040-style LCA of that flowsheet expressed in eco-costs across 14 categories (acidification, water stress, biodiversity and land-use change, carbon footprint, freshwater ecotoxicity, eutrophication, human toxicity cancer and non-cancer, landfill, metals scarcity, particulate matter, photochemical ozone, plastic soup, resource use), framed against the ESPR and the fact that wearables emit 1.1-6.1 kg CO2e per device.
dry.frameworks_zh: 五個模型，每個都綁定一個設計問題。(1) LCST 預測：以 XGBoost 迴歸器在 230 筆文獻整理的資料上訓練，從序列組成、長度、電荷、疏水性與溶液條件預測 ELP 轉變溫度，並施加單調性約束，強制預測的 LCST 隨 NaCl、ELP 濃度或疏水性上升而下降；在依組成分組的 5 折交叉驗證下，對六個超參數做 216 組合的窮舉網格搜尋，並保留一組 43 筆、只涵蓋 10 條獨特序列的測試集；MAE 3.17 °C，優於 Meyer-Chilkoti 經驗關係式的線性擬合、5 近鄰模型與平均值基準線。(2) 分子動力學：在 OpenMM 8.2 中使用 CALVADOS 0.8.0 搭配 CALVADOS 2 的殘基參數（每個殘基一顆珠、隱式溶劑、Debye-Huckel 屏蔽、293.15 K、10 fs 時間步、Langevin 恆溫器），在台夫特理工大學的超級電腦 DelftBlue 上模擬 16 條鏈的表面接枝 ELP 刷層——明確選擇這條路線，是因為 ELP 本質上是無序蛋白質，AlphaFold 的用處有限。三個 MD 模組分別解析水膠硬度（以鏈間離胺酸接觸作為替代指標）、交聯位置（形成橋接、還是浪費在鏈內迴圈）與 RGD 模體的溶劑可及性，並以反應曲面模型與逐一離胺酸迴歸分析。(3) 體學導引的模體選擇：跨 Human Protein Atlas 的 bulk RNA-seq、Proteome Atlas 的 DIA-MS 強度、透過 CZ CELLxGENE 取得的 Tabula Sapiens 單細胞資料，以及 GEO 資料集（GSE104782、GSE169396、GSE147287、GSE114007）進行一項基於富集程度的檢定，並依基質體、整合素與蛋白酶類別註解，各資料集設有各自門檻（HPA：高於其他組織平均值 4 倍且大於 1 nTPM，另對 ECM 配體加設 10 nTPM、對整合素加設 3 nTPM 的較嚴下限），為每種植入組織產出一個 ECM 黏附區域、一個整合素標靶與一個可作為標靶的蛋白酶。(4) 大規模生產：在 SuperPro Designer 中建立先導製程，三座串聯反應器達到 5.11 g/L ELP，規模設定為可塗覆 1.17 億與 2,200 萬台連續血糖監測器，並具備完整的分解代謝、合成代謝與甘油代謝平衡，下游則包含 ITC／鹽析、均質化、絮凝、離子交換與冷凍乾燥。(5) 環境衝擊：對該流程圖做 ISO 14040 形式的生命週期評估，以生態成本表示，涵蓋 14 個類別（酸化、水資源壓力、生物多樣性與土地利用變化、碳足跡、淡水生態毒性、優養化、人體毒性之致癌與非致癌、掩埋、金屬稀缺、懸浮微粒、光化學臭氧、塑膠濃湯、資源使用），並以 ESPR 以及穿戴式裝置每台排放 1.1–6.1 kg CO2e 的事實作為對照框架。
dry.dataviz: Best Wiki winner, and the mechanics are worth copying: the wiki is authored in Markdown with structured components (Image with named figure references, FigNum auto-numbering, Collapsable deep-dive blocks, Reference by DOI) and it publishes a machine-readable mirror - every page is served as plain .md at /tu-delft/<page>.md with an llms.txt index, so the whole wiki is readable without JavaScript. The MOSAIC Designer ships as a live four-step in-browser app (annotate, codon-shuffle, swap, assemble-and-export). The clearest single visual argument is a pair of dot plots of the same six-VPGVG protein: one codon per amino acid leaves 190 repeated 8 nt stretches as diagonal stripes, the scrambled spelling leaves 3. The scale-up model is presented as an interactive flowsheet where clicking any equipment unit opens its specifications and stream details, and the entrepreneurship page carries a BOM Sankey, a company-analysis matrix and a CGM signal/lag model.
dry.dataviz_zh: 最佳 Wiki 得主，而其技術做法值得照抄：wiki 以 Markdown 撰寫，搭配結構化元件（Image 帶具名圖號引用、FigNum 自動編號、Collapsable 深入段落、以 DOI 引用的 Reference），並發佈一份可被機器讀取的鏡像——每一頁都在 /tu-delft/<page>.md 以純 .md 形式提供，另附 llms.txt 索引，因此整個 wiki 不需 JavaScript 也能閱讀。MOSAIC Designer 以瀏覽器內四步驟的實際應用程式發佈（註解、密碼子打散、替換、組裝並匯出）。最清楚的單一視覺論證是同一個含六段 VPGVG 蛋白質的兩張點圖：每個胺基酸只用一種密碼子時，留下 190 段重複的 8 nt 片段，呈現為斜向條紋；改用打散的拼法後只剩 3 段。放大模型以互動式流程圖呈現，點選任一設備單元就會開啟其規格與物流細節；創業頁面則有一張 BOM 桑基圖、一個公司分析矩陣與一個 CGM 訊號／延遲模型。
dry.datascience: Their data engineering is as careful as the modelling. For LCST they searched 86 candidate sources (71 papers or reviews, 15 patents) and hand-extracted sequence, transition temperature, ELP-to-buffer concentration, buffer type, pH and added NaCl; where values existed only as published figures they built their own browser-based LCST Extractor that calibrates axes against tick marks, lets the user trace points along a curve, smooths with LOESS and takes the transition temperature from the steepest change in absorbance - a reproducible digitisation step instead of visual estimation. They treat two rows as the same ELP when amino acid composition matches and keep all rows of one ELP in the same fold, which is an explicit leakage guard, and they document the limitation that composition-only features cannot distinguish block from alternating arrangements of the same residues. The omics pipeline is the other half: it converts public transcriptomic and proteomic atlases into concrete, orderable sequence recipes per tissue, with documented fallback motifs when no tissue signature resolves.
dry.datascience_zh: 他們的資料工程做得和建模一樣細。為了 LCST，他們檢索 86 個候選來源（71 篇論文或綜述、15 件專利），人工擷取序列、轉變溫度、ELP 對緩衝液的濃度、緩衝液種類、pH 與額外添加的 NaCl；若數值只存在於已發表的圖中，他們自建瀏覽器端的 LCST Extractor，以刻度線校正座標軸，讓使用者沿曲線描點，以 LOESS 平滑，並取吸光度變化最陡處作為轉變溫度——這是一個可重現的數位化步驟，取代目測估計。當胺基酸組成相同時，他們把兩列資料視為同一條 ELP，並把同一條 ELP 的所有資料列放在同一折內，這是明確的資料洩漏防範；他們也記錄了限制：只用組成特徵無法區分同樣殘基是以區塊式還是交替式排列。體學流程是另一半：它把公開的轉錄體與蛋白體圖譜轉換成每種組織具體、可直接下單的序列配方，並在找不出組織特徵時記錄備用模體。
dry.software: Four tools on iGEM GitLab. MOSAIC ELP Designer (https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/mosaic-elp-designer) solves the problem that repetitive ELP genes are near-impossible to synthesise: it annotates a pasted protein into parts and linkers, codon-scrambles the parts using a De Bruijn-window repeat check (default k = 3 codons, repeats counted from 6 to 18 nt, homopolymer rule on, BsaI/NdeI/BseRI/BamHI/XbaI excluded on both strands), designs compatible Golden Gate cut sites in the locked linkers so every new part combination assembles with the same overhangs, checks synthesisability, and exports order-ready library sequences; it runs as a web app at https://2026.igem.wiki/tu-delft/designer. LCST Prediction (https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/lcst-prediction) is a Python pipeline with clean_data.ipynb, features.py, train_model.py, test_model.py, run_pipeline.py and predict.py, and bundles the LCST Extractor digitiser under tools/curve_extract. Molecular Dynamics Simulator (https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/molecular-dynamics-simulator) wraps the CALVADOS/OpenMM brush setup and per-module analysis. Tissue-Specific ELP Design (https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/tissue-specific-elp-design) is the omics pipeline. Data deposited at doi:10.5281/zenodo.23532676.
dry.software_zh: iGEM GitLab 上四項工具。MOSAIC ELP Designer（https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/mosaic-elp-designer）解決重複性高的 ELP 基因幾乎無法合成的問題：它把貼入的蛋白質註解為部件與連接子，以 De Bruijn 視窗重複檢查打散部件的密碼子（預設 k = 3 個密碼子，重複長度從 6 計算到 18 nt，啟用同聚物規則，並在雙股上排除 BsaI/NdeI/BseRI/BamHI/XbaI），在鎖定的連接子中設計相容的 Golden Gate 切位，使每一組新的部件組合都能以相同的 overhang 組裝，再檢查可合成性，最後匯出可直接下單的函式庫序列；它也以網頁應用程式的形式在 https://2026.igem.wiki/tu-delft/designer 運行。LCST Prediction（https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/lcst-prediction）是一條 Python 流程，包含 clean_data.ipynb、features.py、train_model.py、test_model.py、run_pipeline.py 與 predict.py，並把 LCST Extractor 數位化工具收錄在 tools/curve_extract 下。Molecular Dynamics Simulator（https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/molecular-dynamics-simulator）封裝了 CALVADOS/OpenMM 的刷層設定與各模組分析。Tissue-Specific ELP Design（https://gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/tu-delft/tissue-specific-elp-design）則是那條體學流程。資料存放於 doi:10.5281/zenodo.23532676。
stack: Tabula Sapiens via CZ CELLxGENE Census
techniques: monotonic feature constraints encoding known physics into a tree model
composition-grouped cross-validation as a leakage guard
exhaustive grid search with 5-fold CV on the training split only
benchmarking against a published empirical equation, kNN and a mean baseline
coarse-grained MD of intrinsically disordered proteins
response surface modelling and per-lysine regression on MD trajectories
enhancement-based tissue-specificity testing across four omics resolutions
techno-economic process simulation with full metabolic balances
ISO 14040 life-cycle assessment in single-indicator eco-costs
figure digitisation with axis calibration and LOESS
repeat-aware codon optimisation for synthesisable repetitive genes

good.publicEngagement: Outreach was built as two-way exchange rather than broadcast, and the recurring artefact is the DNA bracelet: visitors translate a DNA sequence to RNA to protein, each protein becoming a differently coloured bead, so they leave with both the concept and the object. They ran it at the Weekend of Science on the TU Delft campus in The Hague (part of a national programme of 2,000 activities in one weekend), at Neighbours' Day in the district where team members live using beads donated by a local artist, and alongside a codon wheel and a 'building blocks' horse-race game. They put a pond scoop next to a microscope and taught children to focus it, letting curiosity do the teaching for the younger visitors who found the implant problem itself uninteresting. Delft Dialogue brought the Human Practices co-lead, team lead and outreach manager on to discuss the technology's implications for medicine. They also hosted a PhD student from the Daan Brinks Lab for a cloning knowledge exchange and met other iGEM teams, noting specifically what they learned from Brussels' bees and Wageningen's PFAS project.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 外展活動被設計成雙向交流而非單向播送，反覆出現的產出是 DNA 手鍊：參觀者把一段 DNA 序列轉譯成 RNA 再轉成蛋白質，每種蛋白質對應一顆不同顏色的珠子，於是他們同時帶走概念與實物。他們在海牙台夫特理工校區的 Weekend of Science（一個週末內 2,000 場活動的全國性計畫的一部分）辦過，也在隊員居住的社區的 Neighbours' Day 辦過，珠子由當地一位藝術家捐贈，同場還有密碼子轉盤與一個「積木」賽馬遊戲。他們在顯微鏡旁放了一支撈池水的網勺，教孩子自己對焦，讓好奇心替他們教學——對那些覺得植入物問題本身很無聊的年幼參觀者尤其有效。Delft Dialogue 則請來 Human Practices 共同負責人、隊長與外展經理，討論這項技術對醫療的意涵。他們也接待了 Daan Brinks Lab 的一位博士生進行選殖技術交流，並與其他 iGEM 隊伍交流，特別提到從布魯塞爾隊的蜜蜂專案與 Wageningen 隊的 PFAS 專案學到的東西。
good.ihp: Best IHP winner, and the structure is the reason. They used Value Sensitive Design in three explicit passes - conceptual (who MOSAIC affects), empirical (13 semi-structured interviews plus literature) and technical (values translated into design requirements) - adapted the Rathenau Institute's iGEM Guide to the Future into five actor groups (directly affected, those who govern access, industry, those who inform, nature), placed every actor on a power-interest grid using two questions (can this actor formally block market access, and does it have a direct stake), borrowed a 1-3 MCDA scoring scale to extend GRADE, and got formal TU Delft Human Research Ethics Committee approval before any interviews. Requirements they could not meet this year became explicitly labelled Future Perspectives rather than quiet omissions. The concrete changes: a philosopher of technology pointed out that modularity is simultaneously the strength and the regulatory risk, which pushed them to involve patients, clinicians and regulators while the construct was still open and to be wary of words like 'biomimicry' that make people assume safety. Antibiotic-resistance concerns made them drop antibiotics from the antimicrobial module entirely and search the literature for alternatives, landing on antimicrobial peptides. Kirby Lattwein (Erasmus MC, cardiovascular device infections) said their assays would not predict real-world performance, so they switched to clinically relevant strains and media and ran the AMP work in her lab on three clinical isolates from LVAD driveline infections plus two reference strains, and added LVAD drivelines as a use case. Surgeon Robin Atallah told them every minute in the operating room costs 50-70 euros and that surgeons resist deviating from routine, which pushed them toward a manufacturer-pre-coated implant rather than an in-theatre paste. Ambiguity about protein coatings in permanent blood contact made them set blood-contacting implants aside and focus on tissue-embedded and skin-crossing implants. Amir Zadpoor's point that loosening is a major failure mode drove the omics-guided motif model. A CGM industry interviewee's distinction between sensor and adhesive focused the MVP on the inserted sensor and his warning that manufacturers have little incentive to reduce sensor replacement sales sent the entrepreneurship team back to the business model.
good.ihp_zh: 最佳整合式人類實踐得主，而結構正是得獎原因。他們以三個明確階段運用價值敏感設計——概念階段（MOSAIC 影響到誰）、實證階段（13 場半結構訪談加上文獻）與技術階段（把價值轉譯為設計需求），並把 Rathenau Institute 的 iGEM Guide to the Future 改寫成五類行動者（直接受影響者、管控取得管道者、產業、提供資訊者、自然），再以兩個問題（這個行動者能否正式阻擋市場准入、以及它是否有直接利害關係）把每個行動者定位在權力—利益矩陣上，另外借用 1–3 分的 MCDA 評分尺度來擴充 GRADE，並在任何訪談之前取得台夫特理工大學人類研究倫理委員會的正式核准。今年做不到的需求被明確標示為 Future Perspectives，而不是悄悄省略。具體的改變如下：一位技術哲學家指出模組化同時是強項也是法規風險，這促使他們在構築體還開放時就納入病人、臨床醫師與法規人員，並對「生物擬態」這類會讓人誤以為安全的字眼保持警覺。對抗生素抗藥性的顧慮使他們把抗生素完全從抗微生物模組中移除，並回頭查文獻尋找替代方案，最後落在抗菌肽。Kirby Lattwein（Erasmus MC，心血管裝置感染）指出他們的分析方法無法預測真實世界表現，於是他們改用臨床相關菌株與培養基，並在她的實驗室中以三株來自 LVAD 傳動線感染的臨床分離菌加上兩株參考菌株進行抗菌肽實驗，也把 LVAD 傳動線納為應用場景。外科醫師 Robin Atallah 告訴他們，手術室裡每一分鐘要花 50–70 歐元，而外科醫師抗拒偏離既有流程，這把他們推向由製造商預先塗覆的植入物，而非在手術室現場塗抹的膏劑。蛋白質塗層在永久接觸血液情境下的不確定性，使他們暫時放下接觸血液的植入物，專注於埋入組織與穿皮的植入物。Amir Zadpoor 指出鬆動是主要的失效模式，這推動了體學導引的模體模型。一位 CGM 產業受訪者區分了感測器與黏貼膠，使 MVP 聚焦在植入體內的感測器；而他提醒製造商幾乎沒有動機去減少感測器替換的銷售，則讓創業小組回頭重做商業模式。
good.realWorld: The MVP is deliberately the hardest possible test rather than the best-performing coating: a single construct, (VPGIG)23-VPGKG-LDASTVYAVTGRGDSPASSAASA-(VPGIG)24, with one lysine placed directly beside the RGD domain mid-chain, bonded through that lysine to a polydopamine-primed CGM polyurethane membrane, validated by QCM-D for attachment and a cell-adhesion assay against scrambled-RDG and lysine-free controls on the same purified batch. Commercially they chose continuous glucose monitors after a regulatory-driven application screen: they studied EU MDR and FDA pathways in detail (notified body versus 510(k)/PMA, Rule 14 class III escalation when a coating carries an active substance, Annex IX 4.10 review for changes to an approved device) and let that analysis eliminate candidates. The business model is ELP supply paid as a royalty per coated sensor, set as a share of the partner's net price per sensor, which they justify as how medical-technology licences are normally priced, with contracts structured to limit risk. They ran TAM/SAM/SOM, Porter's Five Forces, SWOT with explicit strategies, CGM market consolidation and GLP-1 agonist trend analysis, and three competitor case studies (LipoCoat, Surmodics, Bactiguard). Scale-up is costed for 117 million and 22 million CGMs per year with full technical and financial KPIs, backed by the LCA. IP is mapped as US and European ELP patent landscapes against TU Delft's ownership policy, with an explicit discussion of IP versus open-source science. A 3D-printed-organ bioink route is flagged as future work, since ELPs phase-transition reversibly above a set temperature.
good.realWorld_zh: MVP 刻意設計成最嚴苛的測試，而不是表現最好的塗層：單一構築體 (VPGIG)23-VPGKG-LDASTVYAVTGRGDSPASSAASA-(VPGIG)24，在鏈中段 RGD 區域旁邊只放一個離胺酸，並透過該離胺酸鍵結到以聚多巴胺預處理的 CGM 聚胺酯薄膜上，以 QCM-D 驗證附著，並在同一批純化產物上，以打亂序列的 RDG 與無離胺酸的對照組進行細胞黏附試驗。商業上，他們在一輪由法規驅動的應用篩選後選定連續血糖監測器：他們詳細研究歐盟 MDR 與 FDA 的途徑（公告機構對比 510(k)/PMA、當塗層帶有活性物質時依規則 14 升級為第三類、核准器材變更時依附錄 IX 第 4.10 節審查），並讓這份分析淘汰其他候選。商業模式是 ELP 供應以每片已塗覆感測器的權利金計價，設定為合作夥伴每片感測器淨價的一定比例，他們以醫療科技授權的常見定價方式為理由，並以能限縮風險的方式設計合約。他們做了 TAM/SAM/SOM、波特五力分析、附明確策略的 SWOT、CGM 市場整併與 GLP-1 受體促效劑趨勢分析，以及三個競爭者案例研究（LipoCoat、Surmodics、Bactiguard）。放大生產則依每年 1.17 億與 2,200 萬台 CGM 計算成本，附完整的技術與財務 KPI，並以 LCA 為後盾。智慧財產權部分，他們把美國與歐洲的 ELP 專利佈局對照台夫特理工大學的所有權政策加以盤點，並明確討論了智財與開源科學之間的張力。3D 列印器官用生物墨水的路線被標為未來工作，因為 ELP 在特定溫度之上會可逆地發生相變。

images.caption: What the MOSAIC Designer takes over: from a researcher's amino acid sequence through part identification, codon scrambling, Golden Gate cut-site design and synthesis feasibility checks to order-ready library sequences.
images.caption_zh: MOSAIC Designer 接手了哪些工作：從研究者的胺基酸序列，經過部件識別、密碼子打散、Golden Gate 切位設計與合成可行性檢查，一路到可直接下單的函式庫序列。

images.caption: The MOSAIC Designer annotation step in the browser: a pasted sequence split into parts and linkers, each listed with its range, length and sequence, auto-filled from the detected repeat motif.
images.caption_zh: 瀏覽器中的 MOSAIC Designer 註解步驟：貼入的序列被切分為部件與連接子，各自列出範圍、長度與序列，並由偵測到的重複模體自動填入。

images.caption: The omics-guided motif selection pipeline: public transcriptomic and proteomic data filtered to implant-relevant tissues, annotated by matrisome, integrin and protease category, and reduced by an enhancement test to a per-tissue coating recipe.
images.caption_zh: 體學導引的模體選擇流程：公開的轉錄體與蛋白體資料先篩選到與植入物相關的組織，依基質體、整合素與蛋白酶類別註解，再以富集程度檢定收斂成每種組織的塗層配方。

images.caption: The DNA bracelet workshop, run at the Weekend of Science and Neighbours' Day: visitors translate DNA to RNA to protein, with each protein becoming a coloured bead they take home.
images.caption_zh: 在 Weekend of Science 與 Neighbours' Day 舉辦的 DNA 手鍊工作坊：參觀者把 DNA 轉譯成 RNA 再轉成蛋白質，每種蛋白質變成一顆可以帶回家的彩色珠子。

gemsTakeaway: Adopt their two cheap, high-leverage habits. First, build known physics into a small model instead of hoping it learns it: monotonic constraints on NaCl, concentration and hydrophobicity let 230 hand-curated data points beat a published empirical equation, which is exactly the regime a school lab works in. Second, make the wiki machine-readable - authoring pages as Markdown and publishing them at <page>.md with an llms.txt index cost them almost nothing and made the Best Wiki winner fully legible to any reader or tool, including judges skimming on a bad connection.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 值得採用他們兩個便宜又高槓桿的習慣。第一，把已知的物理直接寫進小模型，而不是指望模型自己學會：對 NaCl、濃度與疏水性施加單調性約束，讓 230 筆人工整理的資料點勝過已發表的經驗公式，而這正是學校實驗室所處的資料規模。第二，讓 wiki 可被機器讀取——用 Markdown 撰寫頁面、並在 <page>.md 發佈，再加一份 llms.txt 索引，幾乎沒有額外成本，卻讓這個最佳 Wiki 得主對任何讀者或工具都完全可讀，包括在連線品質不佳時快速瀏覽的評審。
